newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen weak.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen weak.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.04 down at 41.52 to the dollar on Thursday amid a short dollar supply and will remain weak in near term, dealer said.

"The dollar supply is short because money changers are short of funds," dealer Abdul Ghaffar said. "The dollar will be around 42 rupees level by July because of the country's weak economic fundamentals."

The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar. The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates was 2.70 percent compared to 2.60 percent on Wednesday. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
